note: Starting values, NOT measured facts. Calibrate on the target PC with the S02 (UI) and S07 (OpenCV) baselines, then change status to 'calibrated'. Numbers are only comparable on the same machine: every run records a machine fingerprint.

uiConfirmation.scope: U1a U1b U2 U3 U4 I1 I2 I3 I4 I5 I6
uiConfirmation.note: The user confirmed the UI numbers and the three definitions marked 'definition' below. They stay 'proposed' until S02 and S04 calibrate them.

uiCalibration.note: S02 measured U1a, U1b, U4, I1, I2, I5 on one machine (see docs/steps/S02-ui-shell/perf.md for method, machine and caveats). No limit was changed: the user confirmed these numbers in S01. 'measured' holds p95 in ms from the S02 baseline: 'offscreen' is Qt software-raster CPU time; 'window' is the same code in a real window (backing store present included), measured for a subset only. U2, U3, I3, I4, I6 were measured in S04: see uiCalibrationS04.

uiCalibrationS04.note: S04 measured U2, U3, I3, I4, I6 on one machine, offscreen platform only (see docs/steps/S04-presenter/perf.md for method, machine and caveats). No limit was changed. 'measured' holds the range of p95 in ms over 3 runs of the same build. U2, I3, I4, I6 are inside their limits. U3 is OVER its limit at every size that was measured (5832 components: p95 46-61 ms against 16 ms; the cause and the options are in perf.md). The test records U3 as a known over-budget item and does not fail on it. The decision on U3 (cut the cost, or change the definition) is open and belongs to the user. No real-window measurement was made in S04.

searchCalibrationS05.note: S05 measured T3 on one machine (see docs/steps/S05-lattice/perf.md for method, machine and caveats). No limit was changed. 'measured' holds the range over 3 runs of the same build. T3 is inside its limit. The first version of the estimator was over the limit (p95 3.3-3.6 ms over 3 runs); perf.md shows the profile and the changes. The other T budgets need a real back end (S07, S08, S10).

searchCalibrationS08.note: S08 measured T2b with the HALCON back end (3 runs of the same build plus a 4th run of perf_halcon; see docs/steps/S08-halcon/perf.md). No limit was changed. T2b was over its limit in 1 of 3 runs, when the whole machine was slower. HALCON was also measured for T1, T4, T6a, T6b and T7 on the same boards as OpenCV, in the same process (CV-* in the baseline): T1 p95 7.0-22.0 ms, T4 p95 28.6-46.6 ms, T6a 100 percent, T6b p95 0.48 px (limit 0.5), T7 about 3-7 ms per type with one find_shape_models call. These ids keep the S07 OpenCV numbers in 'measured'; whether the two back ends need separate ids is a decision for S10.

searchCalibrationS07.note: S07 measured T1, T2a, T4, T6a and T6b with the OpenCV back end on synthetic boards, 3 runs of the same build (see docs/steps/S07-opencv/perf.md for method, machine and caveats). No limit was changed. 'measured' holds the ranges over 3 runs. All five are inside their limits. The first version of the searcher was over T2a and T4 (p95 263 ms and 120 ms in one run); perf.md shows the change. T7 (library match against N candidate types) was measured too: about 8-9 ms per type, linear in N. Its limit is a proposal in perf.md and is not in this file, because a new limit is the user's decision. T2b needs HALCON (S08); T5 needs the UI path (S10).

Result ready to first painted frame, 5000 boxes

budgets.definition: Applies to parameters that re-filter cached candidates, such as the score threshold. A parameter that needs a new search is debounced (120 ms) and falls under T5.
budgets.note: Over the limit. Most of the time is the repaint of the whole canvas (about 19-30 ms of the median for 5832 boxes), not the re-filter (about 0.3-1 ms). The limit is close to the cost of one full repaint of the canvas (compare I1).

budgets.metric: Open 5 MP image to first paint
budgets.definition: Record decode time and first-paint time as two parts. S02 measures BMP, PNG and JPEG, then calibrates the total.
budgets.note: Total of decode and first paint. Decode dominates (BMP 39 ms, PNG 121 ms, JPEG 61 ms median) and varies with the core Windows picks: without core pinning the same PNG run took 265 ms.

budgets.metric: Pan and zoom frame time p95, 5000 boxes
budgets.note: At the limit: offscreen p95 spans 14.1-20.7 ms over 13 runs of the same code (7 of 13 at or under 16.7), over the limit in a real window (p95 22 ms) and at a 1600x900 viewport. The machine's speed drifts over time for reasons not identified. The budget does not say which viewport size it means. Decision pending: see ADR-009.

budgets.metric: Longest event loop block during a search
budgets.note: The block is the UI thread applying the result (scene build, canvas, tree), not the search. The margin is 16-38 percent and the machine drifts by about 30 percent between runs, so a regression gate must use more than one run.

budgets.definition: Measures the time until the UI is idle. It does not wait for the worker to stop. The presenter drops the late result.

budgets.metric: Sample box drag frame time p95

budgets.note: Whole pipeline to the repaint. The document command alone takes about 0.01 ms.
